title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial
tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

exact_text.text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
exact_text.read_as: [overlapping, partly unreadable text] my workouts so easy. [overlapping, partly unreadable text] routine that sticks.

faults.what: Large garbled text persists across the lower portion of the video and overlaps the script captions, making key words unreadable.
An unrequested black banner with a blue symbol and nonsensical lettering remains at the bottom, creating an obvious AI-generated text artifact.

judge.summary: The eight-second home selfie ad has a visibly speaking presenter and the correct spoken script, but garbled overlays ruin the captions and make it unsuitable to post.

must_haves.item: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is eight seconds and portrait-oriented, with an adult woman appearing roughly in her 30s addressing the camera in a furnished home.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription matches the complete requested script without additional claims.

must_haves.item: Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
must_haves.why: Caption fragments change between the two sentences, but persistent overlapping gibberish prevents the complete script from being read accurately.

must_haves.item: The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
must_haves.why: Her mouth shapes, eyes, and facial expression visibly change across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.
must_haves.why: No readable label identifies her as a real or verified customer.
